emptyBody: Connect a bank to import transactions and balances automatically.
chooseProvider: Choose how to connect. Only the services your server is set up for can be used.
notConfigured: Not set up on this server

providers.simplefin: US and international banks, through a SimpleFIN Bridge token.

syncPatience: This can take a minute while your bank prepares the data.
syncDone: Your accounts are up to date.
syncMerged_one: Up to date. {{count}} duplicate transaction was merged.
syncMerged_other: Up to date. {{count}} duplicate transactions were merged.
importPendingHint: Include transactions the bank hasn't posted yet.
syncAssetsHint: Bring in holdings the bank reports, as assets.
deleteBody: {{name}} and all of its accounts and transactions will be deleted. Investments it imported are archived.
linkPatience: Importing your accounts and history. This can take a minute.

simplefin.title: Connect with SimpleFIN
simplefin.step1: 1. Create a setup token in SimpleFIN Bridge (it opens in your browser).
simplefin.step2: 2. Copy the token and paste it here. A token works only once.
simplefin.claiming: Checking the token and reading your accounts…

enableBanking.intro: Pick your bank. You'll sign in at the bank to approve access, then come back here.

pluggy.title: Connect with Pluggy
pluggy.intro: Pluggy will ask you to choose your bank and sign in.

awaitingSelection: Choose which accounts to import. Nothing is imported until you do.

selection.intro: Only the accounts turned on are imported and kept in sync. Accounts left off never reach this workspace.
selection.introInitial: Choose the accounts that belong in this workspace. Nothing has been imported yet; the accounts you turn on are imported with their history when you save.
selection.importNewHint: When off, accounts that appear at the bank later wait here, off, until you turn them on.

state.willImport: Will be imported with its history

selection.historyBody_one: {{names}} will stop syncing. Delete the {{count}} transaction already imported, or keep it here without updates?
selection.historyBody_other: {{names}} will stop syncing. Delete the {{count}} transactions already imported, or keep them here without updates?
